verdict.rationale: mParticle's Audiences and Composable Audiences docs describe building audiences and connecting them to activation outputs (ad platforms, marketing tools) via one-click integrations, and Composable Audiences is positioned for near-real-time segment updates from warehouse data. However, the evidence doesn't explicitly confirm continuous/near-real-time sync cadence for entry/exit membership across all outputs, nor independent confirmation of sync latency in production. missing for 10: documented sync frequency/latency guarantees, independent/hands-on confirmation of near-real-time membership updates propagating to ad platforms, and clarity on which outputs support continuous vs batch sync.
